# Eve AssemblyLine

> An EVE Online industry planning and production control workspace.

Eve AssemblyLine helps industrial operators plan large builds across New Eden. It focuses on
materials, stock, locations, jobs, hauling, and the decisions needed to keep a production
operation aligned. It does not provide ISK/hour or profitability calculations.

## Public pages

- [Welcome](/welcome): Overview of Eve AssemblyLine and its production-control tools.

## Application tools

- [Production planner](/planner): Create manufacturing plans from requested builds and available
  stock.
- [Compress](/compress): Evaluate reprocessing and compression decisions.
- [Appraise](/appraise): Turn a pasted item list into ISK and volume totals.
- [Stock](/stock): Inspect available stock and where it is located.
- [Jobs](/jobs): Review industry jobs moving through configured facilities.
- [Structures](/structures): Manage structure information used by planning.
- [Characters](/characters): Connect EVE characters for authenticated state and corporation access.

## Access and data

The welcome page is public. Application tools may require an active session and connected EVE
characters. Character, corporation, asset, job, location, and market data is private user state;
it is not public documentation and should not be inferred or indexed. EVE SSO and ESI requests are
handled server-side.

The application uses CCP's EVE Online static data and ESI where applicable. Availability and
freshness of connected character data depend on the user's session and refresh status.
